Pulse for 18 November 2026

The stories from 18 November 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Everyday tool

ChatGPT for Accounting

OpenAI has added an Accounting plugin to the ChatGPT desktop app. It prepares bank reconciliations, invoice entries and month-end reports from your records and templates, as drafts for review.

Long article

New model

Gemini 4 Neon arrives

Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, a model that sits between the fast Hydrogen and the heavy Carbon. Google pitches it for coding, office work and science, at a lower cost per task than Carbon.

Long article

Everyday tool

ChatGPT types as you talk

OpenAI has launched Live Dictation in ChatGPT. Your speech now turns into text while you talk, and the 10-minute recording limit is gone.

Long article

New model

Genie 4 worlds you can edit

Google has opened Genie 4, its most realistic world model so far, to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie. A new prompt typed mid-session changes the world while you move through it.

Long article

AI agents

An agent for after launch

Google Labs has introduced Stitch Loop, an experimental product agent that connects to a codebase and live metrics, looks for what needs fixing and opens pull requests. Nothing merges until a person reviews it.

Long article

Device

RTX Spark desktops launch

Compact Windows desktops built on NVIDIA's RTX Spark platform are on sale from ASUS, Dell and MSI. NVIDIA pitches them as always-on machines for local AI models and agents.

Long article

AI agents

Replit launches Missions

Replit has launched Missions, a product in which a swarm of agents works toward a goal you set, within a spending limit and rules you agree on. It was announced on November 17, 2026.

Long article

Everyday tool

Suno adds video clips

Suno has launched Visuals, a tool that turns songs into short video clips and images. The company announced it on November 17, 2026.

Long article

AI agents

Copilot gets an Autopilot

Microsoft is rolling out Autopilot, an always-on Copilot agent, to customers in its Frontier early-access program. The company announced it at Ignite on November 17.

Long article

New model

OpenAI launches GPT-6.2

OpenAI has released GPT-6.2 Astra, its new frontier model for the hardest projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, an efficient model for everyday work.

Long article

Everyday tool

ChatGPT gets a Sales plugin

ChatGPT for Sales is a new OpenAI plugin that packages everyday sales workflows, from the account list to the follow-up after a call.

New model

Microsoft ships MAI Code 2

MAI Code 2 is a new coding model from Microsoft, built for everyday programming, and the company says it comes close to leading models at a much lower price.
